Job Description
 Are you an experienced engineering leader looking to make a meaningful impact through people, process, and technology? Join our dedicated team of motivated professionals who share a collective passion for progress and excellence!
Based in Cluj Napoca, part of NI, the Test and Measurement group of Emerson, as a Senior R&D Group Manager you will champion organizational process improvements, drive the standardization of project workflows, and build a culture of collaboration, innovation, and accountability, in addition to leading a hard-working team of engineers and project professionals.
In this role, you will drive technical excellence, improve organizational processes, standardize project execution, and foster a collaborative, inclusive engineering culture.
 In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be: 
 People & Organizational Leadership
 Lead, mentor, and develop a multidisciplinary team of engineers and technical professionals.
 Foster a culture of collaboration, innovation, inclusion, safety, and customer focus.
 Support career development, performance management, and team engagement.
 Technical Leadership
 Provide technical leadership and guidance across software, digital, analog, FPGA, and embedded system development.
 Act as a technical partner and escalation point for complex engineering decisions.
 Promote best practices in system architecture, design reviews, and technical documentation.
 Project & Delivery Ownership 
 Prioritize projects and manage technical resources across multiple initiatives.
 Oversee project planning, including scope definition, scheduling, resource allocation, and budget considerations.
 Partner with project management to ensure delivery on time, on cost, and to quality expectations.
 Who You Are:
 You are an experienced technical leader who enjoys balancing people leadership, technical mentoring, and execution excellence. You are comfortable operating in a matrix environment, influencing across disciplines, and creating clarity in complex programs.
 For This Role, You Will Need:
 Bachelor’s degree in Electronics Engineering or a related technical field (or equivalent experience).
 A minimum of 8 years of experience in engineering, product development, or technical project leadership roles.
 Strong understanding of FPGA technology, digital and analog circuit design, and embedded systems.
 Solid knowledge of software design principles and system architecture.
 Demonstrated experience leading and developing engineering teams.
 Preferred Qualifications that Set You Apart:
 Background in test and measurement products or instrumentation.
